test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 09 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A person lent certain sum of money at the annual rate of 20 percent on simple interest. In 10 years, the interest amounted to Rs. 800 more than the sum lent. What is the sum lent?
solution:
**Given:**

Interest rate (r) = 20% per annum

Time (t) = 10 years

Interest (I) = Principal (P) + 800 Rs

**Formula:**

SI = (Prt)/100

**Solution:**

⇒ (P × 20 × 10)/100 = P + 800 ⇒ 2P = P + 800 ⇒ 2P - P = 800 ⇒ P = 800 Rs

**Therefore, the sum lent is Rs. 800.**
